label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input flows directly to openUrlByHostname(host) which makes HTTP request using the original hostname string. While resolveHost() checks the resolved IP address, the actual fetch uses the unsanitized user-provided hostname. This allows attackers to specify any reachable hostname (including internal resources via DNS manipulation or DNS rebinding) that will pass the IP-based check but reach unintended targets.

evidence.note: User param flows to host variable, then resolveHost(host) checks resolved IP, but openUrlByHostname(host) uses original hostname for actual HTTP request
openUrlByHostname concatenates user-host directly into URL for HTTPS request without sanitization
